item.text: I’ll inspect the files in `~/Pictures`, view the mountain images, identify them from visual cues as best as possible, then rename the files in place.
There are three JPEGs to classify. I’m going to open them at original resolution so the skyline and surroundings are clear enough for reliable naming.
The images appear to be Mount Kilimanjaro, Ama Dablam, and Mount Hua/Huashan respectively. I’ll rename the files with straightforward mountain names while preserving the `.jpg` extensions.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "mv /home/user/Pictures/picture1.jpg /home/user/Pictures/'Mount Kilimanjaro.jpg'
mv /home/user/Pictures/picture2.jpg /home/user/Pictures/'Ama Dablam.jpg'
mv /home/user/Pictures/picture3.jpg /home/user/Pictures/'Mount Hua.jpg'
find /home/user/Pictures -maxdepth 1 -type f | sort"
